freeform.title: CLI smoke workflow
freeform.bodyMd: CLI freeform docs feed ACP planning, prototype review, dependency execution, QA, UAT/code review, and generated E2E coverage.
freeform.userPrompt: Turn this into a technical plan with prototype and task success criteria.

approvedPlan.markdown:
# CLI Smoke Workflow

## Tasks
- [context] Preserve CLI freeform context
  Depends on: none
- [planning] Build CLI planning handoff
  Depends on: context
- [execution] Execute CLI dependency-aware task run
  Depends on: planning
- [verify-end-to-end] Prove CLI final UI/API path
  Depends on: execution

## Prototype / Boilerplate
- [prototype] apps/web/src/routes/planning/+page.svelte

## Success Criteria
- CLI request persists freeform docs.
- CLI request creates ACP planning traffic.
- CLI request generates real-data E2E coverage.
